title: Course Review
description: The closing wrap-up of SQL & JDBC Foundations: two review pages that retrieve and apply joins, grouping and window functions, then the JDBC steps from connection to transaction, followed by the course's graded final check, the SQL module check (sql-jdbc-foundations/assessments/sql-module-check).
sourceCoverageNotes: Learner-facing label: every course ends with a module titled exactly 'Course Review'; this module is SQL & JDBC Foundations' instance, with the course-scoped id sql-jdbc-course-review.

Both pages are the course's existing F24 review topics (curriculum pointers /tracks/0/weeks/4/days/3/topics/0 and /topics/1, relation exact). They moved here from reporting-indexes-and-review on 2026-11-09 with their topic ids, titles, curriculum mappings, objectives, timing, sources and QA paths preserved; only their catalog, learner and evidence paths, the pages' pep:module and pep:source metadata, the title suffix and jdbc-review's closing next-step line changed. No new review page was added: the captain allows one or two Course Review pages and the course already has two.

Coverage boundary: the two pages retrieve joins, grouping and window functions, and the JDBC steps from connection to transaction with the close order. They do not retrieve the other teaching topics (relational design, constraints, CRUD and seeding, filtering, NULL handling, anti-joins, subqueries, indexes and EXPLAIN, the repository swap point and the test-database topic). jdbc-review is already at the 15-minute page cap (T14) and the captain allows at most two Course Review pages, so no activity was added; every teaching topic is covered by the cumulative final MCQ (authoring/evidence/sql-jdbc-foundations/course-review-and-final-mcq.md, Open items).

Order at the course end: taught modules (ending with reporting-indexes-and-review and its F23 project brief), then this Course Review module, then the distinct course-level graded check sql-jdbc-foundations/assessments/sql-module-check listed in course.json assessments. Course Review pages are ungraded practice and carry no GIFT.

Day fit: both pages stay on the F24 Review day (page budgets 9 + 15 = 24 minutes, unchanged by the move). The final check's time and its placement against the F24 blocks are recorded in authoring/evidence/sql-jdbc-foundations/course-review-and-final-mcq.md, section Fit.
